name: Sonos
description: Control your Sonos speakers through Home Assistant. The card shows the active group of speakers (for example P5 + P1) with volume and play/pause; tap it to control volume and play/pause, pick a group, build a group by adding or removing speakers, and choose content. Pick the Sonos media players, then enter the address of Home Assistant and a long-lived access token (Home Assistant profile, Security), because apps can only read states and must call the Home Assistant REST API to send commands.
author: Stefan Verstege (newmedia)

fields.label: Name (empty: the name in Home Assistant)

settings.label: Home Assistant address, for example http://192.168.1.10:8123
